paragraphs: The Greens is known for its mid-rise apartment buildings set among landscaped gardens, pools and pathways, while The Views next door adds taller buildings looking out across the golf course and water features. The layout is relaxed, but it can mean a longer walk between a building entrance and the nearest place a vehicle can stop. We ask where our pickup can park closest to your block, then carry items along the paths and out to the truck, so you never haul anything yourself.

When households move after several years in the same apartment, the clear-out tends to uncover a lot: spare-room furniture, old exercise bikes, outgrown children's beds and cupboards full of forgotten things. We can clear one room or the whole apartment in a single visit, separating wood, metal and electronics so they can be recycled whenever possible. Same-day or next-day collection is available when a move comes together quickly, and nothing has to be dragged to the lobby first.

Not every job is a move. Families here often call when a new sofa or bed is on its way and the old one needs to leave, or when a balcony or storeroom has slowly filled with boxes. People working from home use us for desks and office chairs as well. Send a few photos on WhatsApp and we'll confirm a clear price, then arrive with a trained, insured crew that takes everything from inside the apartment.
tips: Tell us your building number and the nearest parking area, since some blocks sit back from the road along garden paths.
Check with building management whether moving furniture through the lobby needs a lift booking or must happen within set hours.
If new furniture is being delivered, book the collection for the same day or the day before so the room is ready.
Gather smaller items into bags or boxes near the front door, which cuts down the number of trips along the paths.
jobs: Old sofa and bed removal before a delivery
Whole-apartment clear-outs after a long tenancy
Storeroom and balcony clearances
Home office desk and chair removal

faq.q: What if the truck can't park right next to my building in The Greens?
faq.a: That's normal here, as several buildings face gardens rather than the road. The crew parks at the closest permitted spot and carries everything along the paths from your apartment. Tell us your building number and where visitors usually park, and we'll plan the route before we arrive.

faq.q: Can you take my old sofa on the day my new one arrives?
faq.a: Yes, as long as we know the delivery window. Book the collection for the same morning or the day before, and the crew will remove the old sofa from inside your apartment so the space is free. Send a photo and we'll confirm the price and a same-day or next-day slot.

faq.q: Do you collect from the taller buildings in The Views?
faq.a: We do. Higher floors simply mean we use the service lift, and the crew still carries every item from inside the apartment down to the vehicle. Let us know your building, floor and any lift booking your management requires, and we'll size the crew to suit the job.

faq.q: Can you clear an apartment I've lived in for years in one visit?
faq.a: Yes. Long stays often mean full storerooms, packed wardrobes and furniture in every room, but we can usually clear it all in a single planned visit. A quick video walkthrough or room-by-room photos help us give you a clear price and bring the right size of vehicle.
